phase_1_rule_review_record.title: Rule Review Record
phase_1_rule_review_record.summary: Build the traceable review record: rule text, status, rationale, support reference, provenance. The monetizable object. Inline panel, not modal. Validation enforces rationale + support before Verified.

phase_2_defensible_verification.title: Defensible Verification
phase_2_defensible_verification.summary: Evidence attachment, audit trail, finalize gate. Every decision traceable by a third party. Reviews become defensible audit artifacts.

phase_3_stac_aoi_support_facts.title: STAC / AOI Support Facts
phase_3_stac_aoi_support_facts.summary: Auto-populate satellite support facts for eligible rules. AOI-scoped. Support, not auto-verification. STAC fills the reserved area from Phase 1.

phase_4_document_workbook_support.title: Document and Workbook Support
phase_4_document_workbook_support.summary: Upload PDD, monitoring reports, workbooks. Extract structured facts for review support. Quick Check integration.

phase_5_exportable_verification_output.title: Exportable Verification Output
phase_5_exportable_verification_output.summary: One-click PDF + JSON export with full traceability. Project-level synthesis. What VVBs pay for.
